DIMENSIONS OF END FITTINGS OF 

REAR SHOCK ABSORBERS FOR 

SCOOTERS AND MOTORCYCLES 



1. Scope — Specifies the shapes and dimensions of end fittings of rear shock absorbers for 
scooters and motorcycles. 

2. Shapes and Types — Shapes of shock absorber ends are shown in Fig. 1 and 2. The end 
fittings shall be of eye-type and U-type.

EXPLANATORY NOTE 

The performance of shock absorbers has considerable effect on the stability of scooters and 
motorcycles. Consequently, a lot of attention has been paid while formulating this standard on the 
adaptability of shock absorbers with different machines in case of exchange of assembly. 

This standard is applicable to the eye-type and U-type fittings of rear shock absorbers only. 
Fittings for special motor vehicles, such as road racers, motor cross and trial racers and open sided 
suspension type have been excluded. If of stud type, the dimensions shall be as agreed to 
between the purchaser and the supplier. 

For other requirements, reference may be made to IS : 5423-1978 'Requirements for telescopic 
type hydraulic shock absorbers for automotive suspension (first revision) 1 . 

In the preparation of this standard, assistance has been derived from ISO 7118-1981 'Road 
vehicles — Motorcycles — Mounting of rear shock absorbers' issued by the International Organization 
for Standardization. However, for U-type end fittings, additional dimensions have been given to 
cover the Indian applications. Reference has also been made to ISO 3833-1977 'Road vehicles — 
Types — Terms and definitions '.
